item.title: Dr. Randy Cale’s Terrific Parenting: Leadership as a parent
item.description: I think it’s fair to say that many of us have had experiences working with others where leadership skills were lacking. Perhaps you’ve had a manager, coach, or friend handle you like you were a ‘subject’ to be told what to do.
